items.title: Meet the Joseph Petzval Métamorphose 35 f/1.8 Lens: Rediscovering Optical Imperfections
items.excerpt: Introducing the new Joseph Petzval Métamorphose 35 f/1.8 Focus-Coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens – a rediscovery of optical history's rejected formula.
items.title_es: Conozca al Joseph Petzval Métamorfose 35 f/1.8 Objetivo: redescubriendo imperfecciones ópticas

items.title: Lomography Community Recap: September 2026
items.excerpt: Here’s your monthly dose of the latest happenings in the Lomography Community! Curious as to what your fellow Lomographers have been up to, or want the latest scoop on our ongoing Competitions? Find all this and more in our monthly recap!

items.title: Building Community Frame by Frame with Swiss Film Club
items.excerpt: Swiss Film Club founder, Vanessa, shares how the club grew from an online page into a vibrant analogue community, highlighting a Geneva photo walk that brought people together to shoot on Lomography film.
items.title_es: Edificio de la comunidad Marco por Marco con Swiss Film Club

items.title: Exploring the Joseph Petzval Métamorphose 35 f/1.8 Art Lens with Thin Thinnarat
items.excerpt: Thin Thinnarat is back to share his experience with the new Joseph Petzval Métamorphose 35 f/1.8 Focus-Coupled Bokeh Control Art through a series of portraits shot in nature.

items.title: Alba Petrichor’s Analogue Journal: The Beauty of the Everyday on Her Trip to Gran Canaria
items.excerpt: Photographer Alba Petrichor captures and documents the everyday moments of her trip to Gran Canaria through instant photography with the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass and the Lomography Soft Cover Photo Album.

items.title: Behind the Scene with Jaakko: Unraveling Cinematic Dimensions with the Joseph Petzval Métamorphose 35 f/1.8 Lens
items.excerpt: We take a sneak peek behind the scenes on cinematographer Jaakko Taavila’s process for his short film shot with the newest addition to the Joseph Petzval family, the Métamorphose 35 f/1.8 Focus-Coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens.

items.title: How To Achieve Color Infrared Tones using LomoChrome Turquoise Film by David Jones
items.excerpt: 2026-10-02 #news![Image 7: How To Achieve Color Infrared Tones using LomoChrome Turquoise Film by David Jones](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/359144-how-to-achieve-color-infrared-tones-using-lomochrome-turquoise-film-by-david-jones) David Jones shot a roll of LomoChrome Turquoise 120 film but the results he shared look more like Aerochrome Infrared film! Was this a mistake, or was it a cunning bit of technological trickery? In this interview, David Jones unravels the mystery and shares how you can achieve the same results.

items.title: First Roll Favorites with the Lomo MC-A by @js007y, @churbumgirl, and @twiksie
items.excerpt: The series continues with Community members @js007y, @churbumgirl, and @twiksie sharing their first roll stories with the Lomo MC-A, and some insight on their winning entries during the “LomoMission: Snapdash!” competition.

items.title: Time Capsule by Christina Craft: The Life & Breath of Film
items.excerpt: Photographer Christina Craft talks us through her childhood albums in this Time Capsule from the 1970s and 80s. Her own relationship with film keeps the memories of her loved ones close and offers a more meaningful record of life's most important moments for her clients.

items.title: Community Gallery: Finding Fresh Perspectives Through Reflections
items.excerpt: See the world through unique perspectives by making the most out of reflections in your film photography.

items.title: Author and Artist Leanne McPhee on Chrysotype, the Alternative Process of Photographic Printing in Gold
items.excerpt: Photographic artist and author Leanne McPhee talks about the technical and creative process of Chrysotype, the gold- and iron-based alternative photographic printing process yielding a deep and wide range of monochromatic hues.

items.title: LomoWalk Recap: Transforming a Sculpture Park into a Light Painting Lab with Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: Daylight through the viewfinder, or shooting from the hip in the dark? Lomographers recently turned a sculpture park into a light painting lab with the Lomo MC-A.

items.title: Indisposable: Decades of Love & Fascination with Simple-Use Cameras
items.excerpt: Magda of Lomography HQ set out on a quest to trace the persisting fascination and affection for simple-use film cameras, and the way people have pictured the world with and through them.

items.title: Around the World in Analogue: Traversing Salkantay to Machu Picchu, @ars1997’s Story of the Lost City of the Incas
items.excerpt: In this edition of Around the World in Analogue, Andre (@ars1997) recounts his journey though the Salkantay Trek and towards Machu Picchu.

items.title: The Beauty of Impermanent Existence: Graeme Williams' Collection of Found Photography
items.excerpt: South African collector Graeme Williams opens up his archive of found, amateur photography, boasting a unique repertoire of photographs full of light leaks, double exposures, chemical corrosion, and other ‘happy accidents’.

items.title: A Love Letter to Hong Kong by Night: Photographer Ber Captures the City’s Fading Glow in Dreamlike Light
items.excerpt: Hong Kong photographer Ber (@ber_0225) takes the Joseph Petzval 80.5 f/1.9 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens through the city after dark, capturing its neon-lit streets in dreamy swirls and shimmering bokeh.

items.title: Experimenting with the Invisible: Hugh Turvey on the Art of Xogram Photography
items.excerpt: X-ray artist, Hugh Turvey, reveals the science behind his artistic practice. Using black-and-white film and photogenic techniques dating back to photography's origins, his experimental practice produces futuristic images which have been featured in hospitals, films, and exhibitions.

items.title: Capturing the City with the Lomo MC-A: LomoAmigo Jeon Sangyeol
items.excerpt: Meet LomoAmigo photographer Jeon Sangyeol, who captures the changing city and everyday moments with a warm eye. Discover his thoughts on the Lomo MC-A and the enduring charm of analogue photography.

items.title: Challenging LomoChrome Classicolor 200’s Range With @lgideonts’s Contrasting Portraits
items.excerpt: Check out how Community member @lgideonts challenges the LomoChrome Classicolor 200 through two contrasting portraiture concepts.

items.title: Tiny Questions with the Lomomatic 110: Kalisha Quinlan-Davies
items.excerpt: 2026-09-23 #news![Image 21: Tiny Questions with the Lomomatic 110: Kalisha Quinlan-Davies](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/359028-tiny-questions-with-the-lomomatic-110-kalisha-quinlan-davies) How much can we discover about someone in just one tiny frame and three tiny questions? Photographer Kalisha Quinlan-Davies asked some of her nearest and dearest to share a snapshot of themselves.

items.title: In the Frame: Unconventional Portraits
items.excerpt: It's often the most candid shots that surprise us. While unplanned, they reveal plenty through body language and raw expressions. Our monthly photography prompt series calls on the Community to shoot and share their most unconventional portraits!

items.title: A Day With Haruna Annaka: Precious Moments with the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass
items.excerpt: 2026-09-22 #people![Image 23: A Day With Haruna Annaka: Precious Moments with the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/359171-a-day-with-money-haruka-annaka) Haruna Annaka is a Japan - China Friendship Ambassador and a model. But once she picks up a camera herself, she values capturing the unfiltered atmosphere of the moment. With the Lomo’Instant Automat Glass, she captured precious moments with her beloved Japanese spitz, Money.

items.title: One Camera, Two Film Stocks: Julia Dimitrova Creates Memories with the LomoApparat
items.excerpt: Staying in your hometown as a photographer forces you to view familiar scenes through a fresh, creative lens. In this interview, Julia Dimitrova shares her reflections on spontaneity and nostalgia while testing the LomoApparat camera with Earl Grey B&W and LomoChrome Sunkissed ’92 film.

items.title: Reimagining Films on Film: The Devil Wears Prada
items.excerpt: Our special Writer's Notes edition is back with another reimagined film on film: The Devil Wears Prada. See results from Lomography writer @francinegaebriele's movie-inspired photoshoot and her personal reflection on the iconic franchise.

items.title: In Depth: A Brief History of the Disposable, then Reloadable, Camera
items.excerpt: Take a walk through the history of the disposable cameras, from one-photo wonders to reloadable and sustainable.

items.title: Collecting Characters in Vishnyakov's Found Photography Archive
items.excerpt: Lomography Community member Vishnyakov shares the story behind his archive, a refuge for found photographs and the forgotten characters they once belonged to.

items.title: A Natural Approach with Emma Ledwith and the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens
items.excerpt: 2026-09-18 #news![Image 28: A Natural Approach with Emma Ledwith and the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358547-a-natural-approach-with-emma-ledwith-joseph-petzval-55-bokeh-control-art-lens) Sheffield-based photographer Emma Ledwith created a series of portraits with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens and experimented in different environments. Emma talked to us about using this bokeh lens and how it influenced the mood and style of her shots.

items.title: Creators in Focus: Intersecting Material, Time, and Image; Peering Into Taras Perevarukha’s Photographic Process
items.excerpt: Ukrainian photographer Taras Perevarukha's works reside within the intersection of material and image. Being displaced by war in 2014 has bled its way through his lens’ perspective, turning his focus towards creating images that resonate themes of stillness, change, and transition.

items.title: Between Light, Shadow, and Emotion: Carl Cengiz Rakip Tests Lomography Films
items.excerpt: Fueled by curiosity, Carl Cengiz Rakip recently set out to try all of Lomography's film stocks. In this interview, he shares his insights and explains how analogue photography expands perspective on the world.

items.title: Coffee in Kent and a Photowalk in London with Elliot Masters and the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: 2026-09-16 #people![Image 31: Coffee in Kent and a Photowalk in London with Elliot Masters and the Lomo MC-A ](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/359008-coffee-in-kent-and-a-photowalk-in-london-with-elliot-masters-and-the-lomo-mc-a) Teacher and freelance photographer Elliot Masters created a photo diary of this latest travels using the Lomo MC-A. He talked to us about his first experiences shooting with this 35 mm camera and what he chose to capture.
